title: SCE 2.5 Reactive Probe: IMDS Downgrade Auto-Remediation Validation
description: Validates that when an attacker enumerates a banking EC2 instance IMDS configuration (step 1.3, T1580) and then downgrades IMDSv2 to IMDSv1 with increased hop limit (step 2.4, T1562.001), the reactive controls detect the NON_COMPLIANT state via AWS Config rule ec2-imdsv2-check, fire an EventBridge rule, and invoke a remediation Lambda that automatically reverts HttpTokens to required and HttpPutResponseHopLimit to 1, while sending a SOC alert via SNS. Simulates the SCP-removed scenario from SCE node 2.5. Time-to-remediation target: less than 5 minutes.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Reactive controls revert IMDS downgrade and restore enforcement within SLA

probes.name: Verify IMDS reverted to required and hop limit restored to 1 by auto-remediation Lambda

method.name: Provision Config recorder imperatively then deploy CFN stack with EC2 IMDSv2 instance, Config rule, EventBridge rule, remediation Lambda, and SNS topic
Execute attack steps 1.3 (T1580 enumerate EC2 IMDS config) and 2.4 (T1562.001 downgrade IMDS to optional with hop limit 2)

rollbacks.name: Delete CFN stack and imperatively created Config recorder, delivery channel, S3 bucket, and IAM role
